items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: he was like the W.C. Fields type

ctx.x: Well I would answer them with an inquiry if I had never heard of that approach I would ask to have the student explain what was involved. And I was trying to think of an example of that and I suppose — it wasn’t Remington, Remington was a great teacher, no, no, no — Philadelphia — damn. There was a — I’ll come up with it — I almost got it. There was a teacher in Philadelphia who taught the — oh damn it. You have a mouthpiece like this. You put it in your face and he would look for are you an upstream or are you a…

Remington — it wasn’t Remington damn it, I’ve almost got the name. And the pivot system. That’s it. You could look up the word “pivot system” you’d have this guy’s name. And there was a lot around the ‘70s, yeah, ‘70s — he was very popular. And there was a lot of people who believed that when you took the mouthpiece you should put it up in your face and find where it fits comfortably and live with it. And this guy had people moving it around a little like this, and he made it kind of a science, it was his thing.…
If one of your better students came to you, let’s say they’ve done two years of a four year degree and they said, “I got an offer to go with Buddy Rich” what would you tell them?
